page21.headline: Many Unhappy Returns
page21.deck: Dr. Duckhook vs His Majesty's Blood
page21.body: His Majesty's Blood presses that cake squarely into Dr. Duckhook's face. Frosting coats the orange bill and the front of the green vest while the warm dining hall erupts. The burger remains magnificent in its box, untouched. Last week The Chili Cheesers made His Majesty's Blood the dish at a public cookout. This week the champion has found a new place setting, and the birthday boy is wearing dessert.

page31.headline: THE NEXT SIX
page31.body: His Majesty’s Blood at D0nkey K0ng and El Niño at Slob on my Dobb pair four 6–4 contenders in the top-seed race. Red Leopards at Three Dreaded Snake and The Chili Cheesers at ObiWan Jacoby are bubble swings, with the 4–6 hosts needing to stop losing ground. The LLC visits Dr. Duckhook: recovery pressure for the visitor, top-seed contention for the host. Those are pressure games, not automatic eliminators. A loss to Seven Deadly Chins does eliminate Mud Dogs. Head-to-head can decide ties; three divisional rounds follow.
